title: Authenticate required governance Actions workflow run and job
summary: The P00 merge observer now correlates required checks with GitHub-authenticated Governance workflow runs and exact jobs; lookalike checks and inconsistent PR/SHA/suite/job evidence fail closed. Live host and branch protection are not deployed.
migration_notes: No released data or application changed. Observer now requires Actions(read) and returns blocked on missing workflow provenance. Operator deployment and protected main remain independent gates.
